author: probablytired
quote:
Less than 30 FPS on a regular PS5 and only 30 on a PS5 pro is already inexcusable in 2026, especially since they could make a performance mode targeting higher higher fps, but just wouldn't so they could sell you this at 60 fps on PS6. 
You can't even do fun GTA things for HOURS. Crimes you can do are limited (eg. can't kill protesters, can't shoot in clubs); the best part of the older GTA games is the ability to cause as much mayhem as possible until you get shot down, and this game can't even make this part fun since what you can do in the beginning is so limited. 
They put a dating sim where you're forced to only date one girl, and it's not even a good dating sim. If I wanted to play a dating sim, I'd play an actual dating sim, at least there I'd have options and not be forced to do chores like a Sim. People saying "this game will teach you how to be a good boyfriend" thinks that being a good boyfriend is being a roomba with abs. 
The writing is also the blandest I've ever seen in GTA. All the side characters are cringe or extremely annoying and punchable. I would say Jason has the personality of white rice, but that's insulting to white rice since it actually goes well with a lot of food and Jason has no chemistry with anyone. Lucia is a terrible person in general and if this game WAS an actual dating sim, she should be dumped immediately for a better girl. 
The only reason it's not getting a 0 is that the graphics look good, but again, ruined by being unable to keep a constant 30 fps. I will be called a broke boy for not having a PS5 pro, but at least I'm a broke boy with standards.
